office_does: A Kitsap County District Court judge hears misdemeanor and gross-misdemeanor criminal cases and traffic infractions, sets bail and holds preliminary hearings; the county's four district judges are elected countywide.
race_blurb: Uncontested: Judge Shane R. Seaman, who won Department 3 in a contested 2022 race, is the only candidate.

candidates.summary: Kitsap County District Court judge since 2022 and assistant presiding judge; previously a Bremerton Municipal Court commissioner and 18-year trial lawyer. The only candidate on the ballot.
highlights: Elected in 2022 with 55.11% over Stan Glisson [S2]
Assistant presiding judge; co-chair of the Council for Independent Courts [S1]
Former Bremerton Municipal Court commissioner, prosecutor and public defender [S1]
